slides.title: Can Spam
slides.description:
This Act may be cited as the "Controlling the Assault of Non-Solicited Pornography and Marketing Act of 2003", or the "CAN-SPAM Act of 2003".

What it requires;

  • The law requires the following for all unsolicited commercial email, regardless of the number of emails sent:
  • Include a way to unsubscribe over the Internet
    • Honor unsubscribes within 10 days
    • Unsubscribe mechanism must work for at least 30 days after message is sent
  • Include the sender's valid postal mailing address
  • Clearly identify the email as an advertisement in some fashion
  • Use an accurate sender name and a valid email address
  • Accurately describe the content of the email in the subject line

questions.question: What does “Can SPAM” Act stand for?

answers.a:: Controlling the Annual Number of Solicitations Programs being Administered and Monitored Act of 2003
answers.b: Controlling the Assault of Non-Solicited Pornography And Marketing Act of 2003
answers.c: Controlling the Assault of Non-Specific Program Act of Marketing of 2003
answers.d: Controlling the Assault of Non-Specific Pornography And Marketing Act of 2003

questions.question: The law requires that each email must include a way to unsubscribe over the internet and must honor this unsubscribe within 24 hours.
You must always describe the content of the email in the subject line.
Once you Unsubscribe the mechanism must work for at least 30 days after the message is sent.
